svg.text: THE WEAVE, PROVEN SPATIALLY · ONE CONTINUOUS PLACE · SATURDAY 13:40
Not an exploration sheet. One worldspace: the daily line (crossing · bakery square · green · high street · market) and the weekly line (homes · Oak · bridge · ground), crossing at the Oak.
every discovery from Sheets 01–06 present and load-bearing · no people, life implied
COMPOSED IN TIME — the same places, different owners
movement answers WHERE people meet · time answers WHEN · together: the rhythm
prams and benches; the Oak belongs
the school tide; the whole town
barrels out, lantern on; the day is

Walk it west to east: your gate → the crossing → the warm step → the board’s news → under the Oak → the awnings → the square → the pub corner → over the bridge with everyone else. Compression and release the whole way; the ground earned, never given.
THE LANGUAGE WORKS WHEN IT BECOMES A PLACE
